title: Diwali
subtitle: Festival of Lights
content: Diwali celebrates the victory of light over darkness. It is observed by lighting lamps, bursting fireworks, and performing Lakshmi Puja. Families come together, clean homes, and enjoy sweets.

title: Holi
subtitle: Festival of Colors
content: Holi marks the arrival of spring and symbolizes the triumph of good over evil. People play with colors, water balloons, and enjoy gujiya and thandai during this joyful celebration.

title: Harvest Festivals
subtitle: Uttarayan / Pongal / Bihu / Lohri
content: These festivals express gratitude to nature and celebrate the harvest. Traditions vary: kite flying (Uttarayan), sweet rice cooking (Pongal), bonfires (Lohri), and cultural events (Bihu).
